name: AkashaOFT (AK1111) mints from an unprotected nonblockingLzReceive1
summary: The AK1111 OFT token exposed nonblockingLzReceive1 without restricting the caller to the LayerZero endpoint, so the attacker minted itself 6.28m AK1111 four hours after deployment and sold them into the AK1111/USDT pair.
notes: Loss is the AK1111/USDT pair's USDT; the minted AK1111 is valued at nothing (rule 12).
